job_title: Front End GUI Developer / Software Engineer
job_description:
Front End GUI Developer / Software Engineer

LOCATION
Reston, VA 20190
CLEARANCE
TS/SCI Full Poly (Please note this position requires full U.S. Citizenship)
KEY SUMMARY
We are seeking a creative and detail-oriented Front End GUI Developer / Software Engineer to join our innovative team. In this role, you will design and develop intuitive, responsive user interfaces that deliver seamless user experiences. Collaborating closely with designers, backend developers, and stakeholders, you will transform concepts into functional and visually engaging web or application interfaces. If you have a passion for crafting beautiful and efficient GUIs, staying up-to-date with modern front-end technologies, and solving complex challenges through innovative solutions, we would love to hear from you!
• ** Please note that our job openings are dynamic and can open or close quickly (much faster than we can publish). If you do not see an opening you are looking for, know that we see almost all types of positons. We strive to keep our listings up to date, but please consider submitting your current resume. Our team will work with you to identify the most recent opportunities that align with your skillset and career goals. We look forward to you joining our family. ***

SIMILAR CAREER TITLES
Front End Developer, UI Developer, Front End Software Engineer, Web Developer, Application Developer, UX Developer, JavaScript Developer, React Developer, Angular Developer, Full Stack Developer, Mobile App Developer, GUI Engineer, Front End Architect, Interactive Developer, ect.
DEGREE (Level Desired)
Bachelor's Degree
DEGREE (Focus)
Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Web Development, Human-Computer Interaction, Graphic Design, Digital Media, User Experience Design, Computer Engineering, Interactive Media, Multimedia Design, Information Systems, Game Design, ect.
ALTERNATE EXPERIENCE
General comment on degrees: Most contracts allow additional experience (4-5 years) in lieu of a Bachelor's Degree. Some contracts give 4-5 years experience credit for a Bachelor's Degree. Some contracts give 2 years experience credit for a Master's Degree. We will work with you to find the right fit.
POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES
• Develop and maintain user interfaces
• Collaborate with design teams to implement UI/UX
• Optimize application performance
• Ensure cross-browser and cross-device compatibility
• Write clean, reusable, and efficient code
• Conduct unit testing and debugging of interfaces

REQUIRED SKILLS
• Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
• Familiarity with front-end frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, Vue)
• Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git)
• Knowledge of responsive design principles
• Understanding of RESTful APIs
• Ability to integrate with back-end services

DESIRED SKILLS
• Experience with animation libraries (e.g., GSAP, Three.js)
• Knowledge of accessibility standards and practices
• Familiarity with Agile development methodologies
• Understanding of design systems and style guides
• Ability to create wireframes and prototypes
• Experience with CSS preprocessors (e.g., Sass, LESS)
